target_applications: embodied-AI research, teleoperation data collection, mobile manipulation development

base_type.value: wheeled omnidirectional; 3 self-developed steering-wheel modules (6 DoF); Ackermann/translation/spin

reach_mm.value: 620 arm working radius; 716 horizontal (861 with gripper); vertical 0-2000

torso_lift.value: 4-DoF torso lift/tilt/swivel; waist yaw ±175°, hip pitch -105~+90°, torso torque 108/180 Nm (rated/max)

actuators.value: planetary-geared electric joint motors; arm joints brakeless (research caveat); A2 arms 7.8 kg each, EE speed 7.5 m/s

end_effector.value: Galaxea G1 force-controlled parallel gripper (100 N, 0-100 mm on R1 Lite variant); repeatability ±0.5 mm

media_at_flange.value: 3-pin aviation plug aux power 24V/12A + 5V/3A; USB3.0/HDMI/Ethernet on torso/base

sensors_head.value: 2x RGB cameras as stereo pair, 120 mm baseline, 1920x1080@30fps, 118°Hx62°V

sensors_base.value: 5x monocular cameras 1920x1080 + 1-2x 360° lidar (905 nm, 360°Hx59°V, IMU built-in)

compute.value: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 32GB class: 8-core 2.2 GHz, 200 TOPS, 32GB LPDDR5, 1TB SSD; dual-SoC 550 TOPS roadmap

software_stack.value: Galaxea SDK + ROS environment; VR/joystick teleop (2.4 GHz, 1.5 km); data collection-training-deployment pipeline; G0 VLA research

safety_compliance.value: research use only, explicitly no consumer certifications; e-stop; arms drop on power loss (no brakes)

availability.value: shipping; China direct + international resellers (US backorder)

deployment_evidence.value: research labs in CN + international; reference platform for Galaxea G0 VLA work; no industrial production deployments claimed

notes: Official docs retrieved via web.archive.org (docs site returned 503 during research). Variants: R1 Lite (1281 mm, 55 kg, 23 DoF, A1X arms, NUC i9, 720 Wh, 0-1.7 m) and R1 baseline (24 DoF, A1 arms). Discovery-sweep claim of 10 kg/arm is WRONG per official docs: 3.5 kg rated / 5 kg max per arm; ~10 kg is dual-arm combined max.
